data.name: Ashiyah
data.gender_notes: Ashiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'sh-y-h' which means 'to give'. Ashiyah means 'she who is given' or 'gift from God'. The name Ashiyah carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ashiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ashiyah is a beautiful name with spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It is derived from the Arabic root 'sh-y-h' which is used in several Quranic verses. In Surah Al-Mulk, Allah SWT says, 'And it is He Who gives (you) wealth or poverty, and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.' (Quran 67:1)
data.etymology: Ashiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Given by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashiyah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
